snippet.title: Gin - The Silver Wind ~ STEAM Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Gin the Silver Wind is it's own take on classic platformer action!
Become a Kamaitachi in this challenging action 2D Platformer.
Get through hazards with the power of the wind and overcome the difficult battles that awaits you!

There is a DEMO Available on Steam!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582780/Gin__The_Silver_Wind/

Follow us for news: https://x.com/JackalBoxGames
